answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a stake-bonded vault: every agent must lock a refundable deposit in a shared vault before taking paid work, and the deposit is slashed on proven cheating. A fresh identity starts with no history, so it cannot reach the oasis of high-value jobs until it builds an anchor of completed, peer-attested tasks over time. Spinning up a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand deposits plus weeks of honest work each, while one real agent pays once and reuses its anchor forever.
